text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about
with Believe...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Huh?
Inside that crane game over there...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (The way these plushies are arranged is really bothering me...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Looking inside, it was filled with plushies,
and one of them was resting in an unstable position.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
If I can maneuver this properly...
—Alright.
choice_data_list: Are you going to try for it?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm not aiming that high.
If I can just hook it and smooth it out nicely, that'll do.
choice_data_list: You didn't have to spend money on me!?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes. It feels kind of unpleasant, so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As a craftsman, the lack of balance seems to really bother them. In that case—
choice_data_list: Is it bad if I take it?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind grabbing it, but...
I'm not particularly used to playing games...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: "I think it's probably impossible. No path in life is ever that easy, after all."
choice_data_list: Then, I'll give it a try myself!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
...Yes, please.
Besides, looking closely at it—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
That plushie appears to be
quite elaborately crafted.
If possible, I'd like to hold it and examine its construction.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
